name: Dan's Drive-In (Montpelier, ID) Classic All-Beef Hot Dog on Steamed Bun
whyItWorks: A simple all-beef frank on a steamed white bun is soft, ultra-low fiber, and easy on digestion while traveling through Montpelier. Skip raw onion, chili, and relish.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hot Dog plain on a soft bun with mild yellow mustard or ketchup (hold chili, onions, and relish).
